changes: The service reports distinct payload-file counts separately from package counts and repeated file placements.
Connection settings accept the declared effect metadata while continuing to reject embedded credentials and unrelated commands.
The harness tabs wrap on narrow screens and with enlarged text.
The account panel explains counted library uses rather than treating repeated downloads as additional monthly usage.
Declared reference artifacts must include the interpretation metadata their format requires.

advisory.live_checks: The 218 checks were anonymous read-only checks of the deployed site. The nine declared hostnames answered HTTP 200. This is not a new paid transaction or a qualification of every native client.
advisory.source_browser_checks: The full local browser run passed 945 of 946 checks and all 195 failure controls. The sole outdated empty-wording assertion was corrected and checked separately. Do not describe that report as a full 946-check rerun.
advisory.catalogue_at_image_release: The observed active catalogue still had 23901 packages and 68822 distinct payload files. The separately prepared 3910-package addition is not claimed as published by this image record.
